items.title: Finding Amazon S3 cost savings with natural language using AWS Quick and S3 Tables
items.summary: Across thousands of S3 buckets, the data you need to cut storage costs sits in different places. Learn how to bring Amazon S3 Storage Lens metrics and server access logs together in S3 Tables and query them with AWS Quick. Find cold data, wasted storage, replication overhead, and request growth by asking questions in natural language.
items.creator: Santosh Setty
